payload.reason: The evidence provides a detailed explanation of how audio and text sequences are combined in the RNN architecture.

claims.text: The model uses dual recurrent neural networks (RNNs) to independently encode audio and text sequences, then combines their outputs using a feed-forward neural network to predict emotion classes.

The audio-RNN encodes MFCC features from audio signals, while the text-RNN encodes word sequences from transcripts, and their final hidden states are concatenated to form the input for the emotion classification.
An attention mechanism is applied to focus on specific parts of the text transcript based on the audio context, enhancing the integration of audio and text information.
